# Jules HOUNDEKANNOU (Enagnon Mahougnon Jules HOUNDEKANNOU)

## Short Summary
Jules HOUNDEKANNOU is an Engineering Student in Computer Science, Systems, Networks, and Information Security at EILCO (Université du Littoral Côte d'Opale). He is a Technical SEO Consultant, Web Developer, and Founder of CoDoc Agency. He specializes in network architecture, infrastructure hardening, technical SEO auditing, and high-availability IT operations.

## Role & Positioning
- **Cybersecurity & Network Engineering:** Infrastructure hardening, blue team operations, VPN architectures (DMVPN, IPsec), firewalling, and threat mitigation.
- **Systems & IT Operations:** High availability, monitoring, system administration (Linux Debian/RedHat, Windows Server), and incident readiness.
- **IT Project Leadership & Technical SEO:** Technical SEO audits, web platform architecture, digital transformation, and vendor/project coordination.

## Technical Core & Expertise
- **Networking & Architecture:** Cisco IOS, DMVPN (mGRE, NHRP), IPsec (ISAKMP, ESP-AES, SHA-HMAC), EIGRP (AS 100), BGP, OSPF, VLANs, Routing & Switching, IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack, Wireshark, GNS3, Packet Tracer.
- **Systems & Security:** Linux (Debian 13, Ubuntu), Windows Server, System Hardening, OpenSSH, iptables (stateful/stateless), pfSense, Active Directory, VirtualBox.
- **Network Services & Protocols:** ISC DHCP, DNS, File Sharing (NFS with root_squash, Samba, SFTP), SSH, ARP, NAT/PAT.
- **Programming & Databases:** C (Data Structures), Java, Python, MATLAB, SQL (MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB), HTML/CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express.
- **Methodologies, SEO & Tools:** Agile/Scrum (Jira), Git/GitHub, Technical SEO Audits (Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs), Microsoft Office Pack (Advanced).

## Featured Projects

### 1. Multisite Network Architecture with Dynamic Multipoint VPN (DMVPN)
- **Role:** Lead Researcher & Network Engineer (Bachelor's Thesis, IFRI - Université d'Abomey-Calavi).
- **Description:** Designed and deployed a scalable, secure multisite enterprise network topology interconnecting Cotonou (Hub), Calavi (Spoke), and Allada (Spoke) under GNS3. Integrated DMVPN (mGRE, NHRP) with IPsec encryption and EIGRP dynamic routing.
- **Key Results:** Reduced ICMP overlay latency from ~91 ms (classic IPsec) to ~76 ms (DMVPN), eliminated single points of failure, and simplified site expansion without reconfiguring existing tunnels.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/j-hdkn/dmvpn-network-architecture

### 2. Corporate Network Infrastructure & Security Audit (SARL Numeryo)
- **Role:** Systems & Security Engineer (EILCO - ULCO Project).
- **Description:** Engineered and secured a virtualized enterprise network infrastructure on Debian 13 (VirtualBox). Deployed persistent dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, ISC DHCP server, and cross-department file sharing (NFS with root_squash, Samba, SFTP).
- **Key Results:** Built a restrictive stateful iptables firewall, hardened OpenSSH via RSA 4096-bit public key authentication (disabling password auth), and performed post-deployment security auditing using nmap.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/j-hdkn/numeryo-network-infrastructure-security
